skills.name: Ministerium
lines: Stack Virtus on ally in the slot to user's right and Stack Virtus on self.
* Grant Kaleido to user based on Stacked ally's Type Personality and Grants Flexible to user based on weapon type (Permanent). Thunder/Shade/Crystal Type Personality is chosen if present
* Virtus add 1/6 of each of the ally with Virtus stat (except HP/MP) to the corresponding stat of user
* Virtus add 1/6 of each of user's stat (except HP/MP) to the corresponding stat of the ally with Virtus
** Effects on game mechanics:
*** Lunatic - Sacrifice is not affected by +END\+SPR parts from stack
*** Base Damage: +STATS increase STAT_stacks parts of damage.
**** SPD damage is affected greater than PWR or INT damage
*** Both direct damage and skill multipliers non-standard stats scaling are affected (Radica AS, Cynthia, Heena...)
** Stacks are removed if User or Ally with Virtus Stack are not in the frontline at turn start or if Virtus is applied to a different ally
* Replaces the basic attack
